'''Chianmai''' was a [[Banner-General]] in the [[Seanchan]] army.

== Appearance ==
His skin was a honey-brown color. 

== Activities ==
[[Varek]] is sent to give an urgent message to Chianmai. Chianmai is found dead, having been killed by one of his own ''[[damane]]''.
